title: Mux UI pattern category registry (catalog/patterns/categories.json)
description: Maps each pattern group to its categories, and each category to its display label, in display order. A group or category id starts with a letter so object key order stays declaration order. A category appears under one group; a pattern's group is derived from its category.

additionalProperties.description: The category's display label, written as it should read: FAQ, Call to action.
